$comment: The Almanac (design doc §7): the permanent tree bought with Verdure, surviving every Migration. Verdure is never spent away — nodes ALLOCATE from the banked total (available = verdurePoints - sum of owned node costs) so the +2%/pt passive keeps counting the full total. All costs and effect sizes are first guesses tuned to ~10 Verdure from the first Migration. requires = single prerequisite node. repeatable = the line is bought over and over, level L costing costVerdure · costGrowth.almanac^L, its effects scaled by the levels held; every other node is a one-off. Two lines are repeatable — The Long Song (passive gathering) and The Long Reach (windfalls) — so Verdure never dead-ends whichever way the warden plays. The exotic lines (grantUpgrade / keepCraftOrders) act at the fold: they scale the ladder RE-CLIMB downward with the fold count — the half of the pacing fix no yield knob delivers. A grantUpgrade of a trail map must have its zone's requiredTool covered by a tool rung granted in its own requires chain (validator-enforced), or the grant would sit inert forever.

nodes.name: The Long Song
nodes.$note: The first endless line, and the reason Verdure never dead-ends. The rest of the tree totals 166 points (87 before the exotic lines and the kept things — Sure Paths left with the hauling system), which a steady warden passes within a handful of folds; after that the currency kept arriving with nothing to spend it on, which is what made a late fold feel like it had nothing in it. Level L costs costVerdure · costGrowth.almanac^L forever. Its carrying half went with hauling: deliveries are automatic and lossless now, so the line is purely the gathering band (yieldBonus sums into mult·(1+bonus)). Its sibling is The Long Reach.

nodes.name: The Long Reach
nodes.$note: The second endless line (2026-07-31), and the counterweight to the flat windfall. A caught bubble now pays bubbles.rewardRatePerSecond · rewardSeconds whatever node it rose from — deliberately, so a windfall stops being worth 1-2 units at the many nodes only a wandering warden half-works — but a flat haul is the one number in the run that does NOT ride mastery, richness, planters or the Verdure passive, so left alone it decays into noise by the late zones. This is where the meta buys it back: +15%/level, additive on the same band as the pack raven's bubbleRewardBonus trait. Priced under The Long Song (6 vs 8) because it pays only on catches the player is present for, not on every passive hour; it forks off old-songs-ii rather than -iii so the gathering trunk offers a choice — more from every hour, or more from every catch — before either endless line opens. Both taper on costGrowth.almanac forever.
